Title: Valid login with standard user
Steps: Enter valid username and password and click Login

Title: Blocked login for locked-out user
Expected Result: Error banner states user is locked out

Title: Empty username validation
Steps: Leave username blank enter password and click Login
Expected Result: Error banner states Username is required

Title: Add and remove item updates badge
Steps: Click Add to Cart then Remove on Backpack
Expected Result: Cart badge updates from 1 to empty

Title: Sort items by price low to high
Steps: Select Price (low to high) from sort dropdown
Expected Result: Item prices appear in ascending order

Title: Complete order with valid details
Steps: Click Checkout fill First Name Last Name Postal Code and Finish

Title: Missing postal code blocked
Steps: Leave Postal Code blank and click Continue
Expected Result: Error banner states Postal Code is required
